visual_identity.core_identity: Large bull-headed humanoids defined by a bovine head, sweeping horns, powerful humanoid torso, and hooved lower anatomy.
visual_identity.silhouette: Broad humanoid shoulders under a large horned bull head; powerful legs end in hooves.
visual_identity.head_features: Bovine head with long muzzle, flared nostrils, bovine ears, heavy brow, and prominent curved horns.
visual_identity.body_shape: Massive humanoid torso and arms with powerful legs; never a centaur body.
visual_identity.surface: Short restrained hide or clean bone structure for undead variants.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Powerful humanoid arms, two bipedal legs, and hooved feet beneath a bull-headed humanoid frame; never four-legged or centaur-shaped.

accuracy_checks: bull head and horns dominate identity
body remains humanoid below the neck

known_failure_modes.correction: broaden bovine muzzle, nostrils, skull mass, and sweeping bull horns
restore bipedal humanoid torso and legs with hooved feet

scene_identity.size_impression: Large, broad, imposing humanoid whose bull head and horn span create scale without turning the body into a quadruped.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Wide grounded stance, controlled turn through a corridor, guarded crouch, or deliberate horn-forward threat with both feet visibly supporting the body.
behavior_style: guarding a gate, passage, or chamber
lowering horns and shoulders in a controlled threat
navigating oversized stone architecture with deliberate weight
environment_fit: underground gates, arenas, and chambers with strong maze geometry
